dataset_name: NASA Soil Moisture: Surface & Root-Zone Climatology
mission_context: NASA SMAP / GMAO Land Surface Assimilation

GWETTOP.smap_equivalent: SMAP L3 Radiometer Surface Soil Moisture (SPL3SMP_E 0-5cm)
GWETTOP.agronomic_role: Seedbed moisture, seed germination, evaporation, tillage workability

GWETROOT.smap_equivalent: SMAP L4 Global Root-Zone Soil Moisture (SPL4SMAU 0-100cm)
GWETROOT.agronomic_role: Crop transpiration, agricultural drought onset, deep root water uptake (maize/cassava/yam)
